info.name: Atlas — Full Local Stack
info.description:
Comprehensive collection for the local Atlas stack — every first-party API (gateway, agent-runtime, both MCP servers) plus the data-plane stores, all zero-spend via MockProvider.

**Setup:** `cd atlas-infra && make local-up`, then import the **Atlas Local (compose)** environment and select it. For the standalone gateway-only container on :8000 use the **Atlas Gateway Standalone** environment.

**Auth:** gateway requests inherit collection-level `Authorization: Bearer {{api_key}}` (dev default `dev-key` from `ATLAS_API_KEYS`). Agent-runtime, MCP, and store requests override to No Auth (OpenObserve = Basic).

**Variables** start with compose defaults; the environment files override them. `run_id` and `mcp_*_session` are populated at runtime by test scripts.

**MCP order matters:** run the MCP folder requests top-to-bottom (initialize first captures the session id). See the README for the handshake explainer.

item.name: Gateway
item.description: OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway (the single choke point). Collection-level Bearer `{{api_key}}` is inherited by every request here except `/healthz`. Base `{{gateway_url}}` — compose :8090, standalone :8000.

request.description: Liveness probe — open, no auth. Expect 200 `{"status":"ok"}`.
Routing surface: list includes `mock`, the provider model ids, and the Atlas aliases (`smart/deep/fast/balanced/embed`). 401 without the bearer key. Expect 200.

A real call through the whole platform (auth -> ChatService -> provider) with zero spend. MockProvider echoes the last user message: expect 200 with `choices[0].message.content` = `[mock:mock] echo: <message>` and a populated `usage`.

response.name: mock echo

request.description: Same endpoint with `stream: true` -> Server-Sent Events: a role chunk, content delta chunks, a final chunk with `finish_reason` + `usage`, then `data: [DONE]`. Postman shows the raw SSE stream. NOTE: streaming is deliberately NOT recorded by accounting, so it adds no `call_records` row.

Same path routed via the Atlas alias `smart` to a real provider/model. Needs a provider key (or local Ollama alias) on the gateway; with the mock-only dev gateway this returns 404 (unknown model). Shown for the real routing shape — `max_tokens`/`temperature`/`prompt_ref`/`prompt_params` are also accepted.
MockProvider implements `embed()` — expect 200 with one 8-dimensional vector in `data[0].embedding` (zero spend). Real embedding aliases (`embed`) need a provider key.
`input` also accepts a list of strings -> one vector per input, index-ordered.

query.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD); defaults to 1st of current month.

request.description: Cost trail: per-(app, model) token + cost aggregates from `call_records`. Expect 200 `{since, rows}` on the compose stack. On the standalone :8000 container (no `ATLAS_DB_URL`) returns 503 "usage data unavailable: DB not configured" — config-gated by design.

item.name: Agent Runtime
item.description: Hand-rolled bounded agent loop (RegDoc Q&A). FastAPI trigger surface — **no auth**. Base `{{agent_url}}` (compose host :8083). A run executes synchronously inside the POST.

request.description: Liveness. Expect 200 `{"status":"ok"}`.

Trigger a bounded run of the **offline** mock spec (`model_alias: mock`, zero spend). Expect **201** with `{run_id, status, iterations, tokens_used, content, responses}`. The test script saves `run_id` so the GET below can fetch it. 404 = unknown agent, 422 = a hard cap breached, 429/502 = upstream gateway error.

request.description: The production spec — `model_alias: gpt-oss:120b-cloud` (local Ollama, free but needs Ollama on the host). The full RAG/citation path also needs MCP doc-search/citations + Qdrant/ES + an ingested corpus, so it may error/refuse locally. Use `regdoc-qa-mock` for a fully offline run.

Fetch a persisted run + steps (uses the `run_id` captured by regdoc-qa-mock). 200 with `{status, token_budget, tokens_used, started_at, ended_at, steps[]}`; 404 = unknown run, 400 = bad UUID, 503 = persistence not configured.

item.name: MCP · doc-search
item.description: MCP server over Streamable HTTP (FastMCP, single endpoint `POST {{mcp_docsearch_url}}/mcp`, JSON-RPC 2.0). **No auth.** Run these IN ORDER: every call needs both `Content-Type: application/json` and `Accept: application/json, text/event-stream` (a missing dual Accept -> 406). `initialize` returns an `Mcp-Session-Id` response header the test script captures into `{{mcp_docsearch_session}}`; every later call sends it back. Responses are SSE (`event: message` / `data: {...}`) — Postman shows them raw. Verified live: handshake works; tool is `doc_search`.

request.description: Open the MCP session. The test script saves the `Mcp-Session-Id` header into `{{mcp_docsearch_session}}` for the requests below.
Required handshake completion (a notification — no `id`). Expect **202**.
List the registered tools — expect one tool, `doc_search`.

Hybrid BM25 + vector search (RRF). Args: `query` (1-2000 chars), `k` (1-50, default 8). Returns `{chunks: [{id, text, source_id, score}]}` as the SSE `data` payload.

**Known local caveat:** doc_search embeds the query via the gateway `/v1/embeddings`. The running mcp-doc-search container has no `ATLAS_EMBED_MODEL`, so it requests a real embed model the mock-only gateway 404s on -> the tool returns `isError: true`. To make it work offline, set `ATLAS_EMBED_MODEL=mock` on the `mcp-doc-search` service in compose.dev.yaml and recreate it.

item.name: MCP · citations
item.description: MCP server over Streamable HTTP (FastMCP, single endpoint `POST {{mcp_citations_url}}/mcp`, JSON-RPC 2.0). **No auth.** Run these IN ORDER: every call needs both `Content-Type: application/json` and `Accept: application/json, text/event-stream` (a missing dual Accept -> 406). `initialize` returns an `Mcp-Session-Id` response header the test script captures into `{{mcp_citations_session}}`; every later call sends it back. Responses are SSE (`event: message` / `data: {...}`) — Postman shows them raw. Verified live: returns exists:true for the seeded golden ids.

request.description: Open the MCP session. The test script saves the `Mcp-Session-Id` header into `{{mcp_citations_session}}` for the requests below.
Required handshake completion (a notification — no `id`). Expect **202**.
List the registered tools — expect one tool, `verify_citation`.

Verify a `source_id` exists in the ingested corpus. Args: `source_id` (non-empty), `claim` (1-1000 chars). Returns `{exists: bool, snippet: string|null}`. Uses `{{demo_source_id}}` — a real golden id in the seeded corpus, so expect `exists: true` with a snippet. **Works fully offline** (no embeddings — pure Elasticsearch + Qdrant lookup by source_id).

item.name: Platform Stores
item.description: Poke the data plane directly to inspect what the seeders/traffic produced. **No auth** (except OpenObserve = Basic). Needs the stack seeded — run the seeders first (README "Fill the databases"). Curated handful, not an exhaustive mirror of these third-party APIs.

request.description: Elasticsearch cluster info — confirms it's real ES (not the dropped OpenSearch).
Count chunks in the corpus index. Expect `{count: 200}` after a 40-doc seed.
Search the corpus. NOTE: `source_id` is dynamically mapped as text+keyword, so an exact match must target **`source_id.keyword`** (a `term` on `source_id` is analyzed and won't match).
List Qdrant collections — expect `doc_chunks` (+ semantic-cache collections if any).
Collection info: `points_count` (~200 after seed) + vector params (size 8 mock, cosine).
Scroll points filtered by the `source_id` payload field — the same lookup the citations MCP server does. Returns matching points with payloads.
MLflow tracking-server health.
List MLflow experiments (eval/drift runs land here, e.g. `atlas-drift`).
OpenObserve (Splunk substitute / OTLP sink) health — open endpoint.
List ingest streams in the `default` org — **Basic auth** (`{{openobserve_user}}` / `{{openobserve_pass}}`). OTel spans/metrics land here.
